name: Development Stage Alignment
description: Matches grant stage requirements to founder's current development stage (data_status). Higher score when founder's stage matches or exceeds grant requirements.

name: Therapeutic Area Alignment
description: Checks if the founder's therapeutic_area matches the grant's therapeutic focus areas. Grants with no specified therapeutic area pass through.

name: SBIR Eligibility Check
description: Verifies SBIR-required criteria: US small business, 500-employee cap, majority US ownership, primary PI employed by SBC. Returns 0 if founder's sbir_eligible flag is false and grant requires SBIR eligibility.
fail_message: Company does not meet SBIR eligibility requirements

name: Funding Ceiling Filter
description: Filters out grants whose minimum award amount exceeds the founder's capital_need_12m_usd or whose maximum award is below the founder's minimum_grant_size_usd.

name: Company Age Restrictions
description: Some grants have company age limits (e.g., must be early-stage, founded within 3-5 years). Checks founder's company_age_months against grant's max_company_age constraint.

name: Product Type Alignment
description: Checks if the founder's product_type (device, drug, diagnostic, software, other) matches the grant's product type requirements.

name: Geographic / Location Match
description: Checks if founder's location (state/country) matches grant requirements. Critical for state-level grants like Michigan MEDC.

name: Regulatory Pathway Alignment
description: Checks if the founder's planned regulatory pathway matches the grant's regulatory expectations.
